messages.subject: Could not run model 2diidwishartpart0  and 2diidwishartpart1
parts:
I tried to run the code from "A primer on disease mapping and ecological regression using INLA" by Schrodle Birgit and Leonhard Held

I could not run the model 2diidwishartpart0  and 2diidwishartpart1 in the R-inla package.

The error message are
[1] "Valid models are:"
 [1] "linear"       "iid"          "mec"          "meb"          "rgeneric"     "rw1"          "rw2"         
 [8] "crw2"         "seasonal"     "besag"        "besag2"       "bym"          "bym2"         "besagproper" 
[15] "besagproper2" "fgn"          "fgn2"         "ar1"          "ar1c"         "ar"           "ou"          
[22] "intslope"     "generic"      "generic0"     "generic1"     "generic2"     "generic3"     "spde"        
[29] "spde2"        "spde3"        "iid1d"        "iid2d"        "iid3d"        "iid4d"        "iid5d"       
[36] "2diid"        "z"            "rw2d"         "rw2diid"      "slm"          "matern2d"     "dmatern"     
[43] "copy"         "clinear"      "sigm"         "revsigm"      "log1exp"      "logdist"     
Error in inla.is.model(model, "latent", stop.on.error = TRUE) : 
Unknown name [ 2diidwishartpart0 ]
  Valid choices are:  linear iid mec meb rgeneric rw1 rw2 crw2 seasonal besag besag2 bym bym2 besagproper besagproper2 fgn fgn2 ar1 ar1c ar ou intslope generic generic0 generic1 generic2 generic3 spde spde2 spde3 iid1d iid2d iid3d iid4d iid5d 2diid z rw2d rw2diid slm matern2d dmatern copy clinear sigm revsigm log1exp logdist

How could I run the ST1, ST2 and ST3 as suggested in the paper? Thank you
